programs.description: A 5-day body-part split for lose-weight goals using full commercial-gym equipment — free weights, cables, and machines. Higher rep ranges and shorter rest periods than a pure muscle-building split, matching NASM Phase 1 Stabilization Endurance principles for a beginner while staying easy to progress from.

A 3-day full-body muscle-building rotation using zero equipment. No true pulling pattern is possible without a bar or rig, so this leans on unilateral squat/lunge work, varied push-up angles, and posterior-chain bridge/hinge work instead. Add rig-based pulling separately if any bar is available where you train.
